review_notes: I read the whole file and the downstream uses of `FiniteChartData.chartMeasure` in ChartMeasureLp.lean and ChartMeasureRiemannian.lean. I also checked Mathlib's IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts instances. The file has no simp attributes and no competing rules. The only simp-interface problem I found is that the definition has no evaluation lemma, so callers unfold it. I could not run Lean, so I haven't checked how the proposed lemma would behave under simp. I did not flag `isFiniteMeasureOnCompacts_of_isFiniteMeasure`, because that is a duplication question and outside this rubric.

findings.excerpt:
noncomputable def chartMeasure (μ : Measure M) (i : d.ι) : Measure E :=
  (μ.restrict (extChartAt I (d.center i)).source).map (extChartAt I (d.center i))
findings.problem: `chartMeasure` is a plain noncomputable def with no companion API for simp or rw: no `chartMeasure_apply` and no `chartMeasure_def`. Downstream code therefore uses `unfold` or `simp [FiniteChartData.chartMeasure]` to reach `Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable`. That exposes the internal `Measure.map (extChartAt ..) (μ.restrict source)` form in goals and hypotheses. Each caller also has to rebuild the `AEMeasurable` side condition, which this file already provides as `aemeasurable_extChartAt`. In ChartMeasureLp.lean, `simpa [FiniteChartData.chartMeasure] using hmap` unfolds the definition inside a `MeasurePreserving` goal. In ChartMeasureRiemannian.lean, `unfold FiniteChartData.chartMeasure` followed by `exact Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf htS_meas` is repeated in two proofs.
findings.proposed_change: Next to the definition, add a definitional unfolding lemma `chartMeasure_def : chartMeasure d I μ i = (μ.restrict (extChartAt I (d.center i)).source).map (extChartAt I (d.center i)) := rfl`. Do not mark it simp, so the map form is not exposed in goals by default. Also add an apply lemma `chartMeasure_apply {s : Set E} (hs : MeasurableSet s) : chartMeasure μ i s = μ ((extChartAt I (d.center i)).source ∩ extChartAt I (d.center i) ⁻¹' s)`. Prove it from `Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable (aemeasurable_extChartAt ..) hs` and `Measure.restrict_apply'` with the open-source measurability. The `∩ source` form is the canonical normal form because `restrict` is evaluated explicitly there. Callers can then `rw [chartMeasure_apply hs]` or `simp [chartMeasure_apply hs]` instead of `unfold` or `simp [chartMeasure]`. Keep `delta chartMeasure` or `chartMeasure_def` for the finiteness instances.
findings.benefit: Downstream proofs about `chartMeasure` stop depending on how the measure is defined. Goals keep the semantic `chartMeasure μ i s` form until a lemma is applied deliberately. The repeated unfold-and-`map_apply_of_aemeasurable` boilerplate with its manual measurability side goals is replaced by one rewrite lemma, so the definition can change without breaking the callers.
